snippet.title: Emma Watson Hated Kissing Ron Weasley | Friday Night With Jonathan Ross
snippet.description:
In an exclusive TV interview, Emma Watson says she hated her long-anticipated screen kiss with fellow Harry Potter actor Rupert Grint: ""I pounced on him, I was so desperate to get it over with."

ORIGINAL BROADCAST DATE: 3 July 2009
Series 16, Episode 22

snippet.title: Emma Watson's Worst On-Set Moments in Harry Potter #HarryPotter #HermioneGranger
snippet.description: Filming Harry Potter wasn’t always magical for Emma Watson! 🎬 From accidentally hitting Daniel Radcliffe a little too hard to literally yanking out his real hair during The Deathly Hallows, Emma had her fair share of cringe-worthy on-set moments. 😬 But nothing compares to her emotional torture scene with Bellatrix or the brutal Gringotts escape — where Emma, Rupert, and Daniel were thrown into freezing water on her 19th birthday! ❄️💔 Talk about a birthday to remember! #EmmaWatson #HarryPotter #HermioneGranger #BehindTheScenes #MovieFails #OnSetStories #HarryPotterCast #emmawatson #emmawatsonstatus #emmawatsonedit #emmawatsonwhatsappstatus #harrypotterbehindthescenes #harrypotterfacts #harrypotterfan #harrypotteredit #harrypottermemes #hermionegrangeredit #hermionegrangeredits
